item.title: Shelby County outlasts Red Bay at Rickwood behind Pickett’s go-ahead d...
item.description: AJ Pickett’s go-ahead double with two outs in the fifth provided the breakthrough for a dramatic Shelby County win over Red Bay at historic Rickwood Field behind a shutdown relief effort from Hunter King.

item.title: Chelsea’s Johnson, Briarwood’s Kerley share Shelby County Coach of the...
item.description: Chelsea’s Denton Johnson and Briarwood’s Lorie Kerley shared the Shelby County Coaches of the Year award for girls basketball thanks to their exceptional leadership during Final Four runs.

item.title: Chelsea’s Caroline Brown named Shelby County Player of the Year
item.description: Chelsea’s Caroline Brown is the Shelby County Player of the Year for girls basketball after stepping up as the on and off-court leader for the Hornets to maintain their standard of success.

item.title: Courting honors: All-County girls basketball team spotlights best of t...
item.description: The 2026 All-County girls basketball team stands as one of the most talented and decorated in history after a season full of standout performances.

item.title: PROFILE: 'Trail nerd' Jack Aured shares outdoor passion with Shelby Co...
item.description: Shelby County Trail Maintenance and Construction Superintendent Jack Aured is living his dream by channeling his love of the outdoors into making the county’s trail system the best it can.

item.title: Alabaster to hold spring Parade of Teams on April 11
item.description: Young athletes will make their away across the field at Veterans Park as parents and friends cheer them on during the city of Alabaster’s annual Parade of Teams.

item.title: ACS Board of Education honors staff, support personnel
item.description: Staff from across Alabaster City Schools were recognized by the ACS Board of Education during a recent meeting.

item.title: Pelham Civic Complex hosts successful Olympic Dream Day, draws 125 ska...
item.description: The Pelham Civic Complex and Ice Arena brought the spirit of the Winter Olympics to the local community earlier this month, welcoming 125 participants to its Olympic Dream Day event on Sunday, March 1.

item.title: Pelham Mardi Party sells out, raises funds for local schools
item.description: The Pelham City Schools Foundation celebrated a sold-out evening of entertainment and community impact during its annual Pelham Mardi Party Casino Night on Saturday, Feb. 28 at the Pelham Civic Complex and Ice Arena.

item.title: Montevallo City Council approves grant application for sewer improveme...
item.description: The Montevallo City Council approved a grant application for sewer improvements at the intersection of State Route 119 and County Road 22 during a meeting on Monday, March 23.
